name: Darting-eye concoction
body:
Source Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 26
Price 50 gp; Weight —
Category Concoctions
Description
This effervescent concoction improves your sensory reaction time, providing a +2 alchemical bonus on Perception checks. However, the mental hyperactivity it creates imparts a –1 penalty on your Will saving throws.
